May be set to `0` to disable virtual tools.

gunner.walkthrough.panelChat.title: Chat about your code
gunner.walkthrough.panelChat.description:
Ask Gunner programming questions or get help with your code using **@workspace**.
 Type **@** to see all available chat participants that you can chat with directly, each with their own expertise.
[Chat with Gunner](command:gunner.chat.open)

gunner.walkthrough.inlineChatNotMac.desc:
Sometimes, it's easier to describe the code you want to write directly within a file.
Place your cursor or make a selection and use **``Ctrl+I``** to open **Inline Chat**.
gunner.walkthrough.inlineChatNotMac.medi: Inline Chat view in the editor. The video shows the user invoking the inline chat widget and asking Gunner to make a change in the file using natural language. Gunner then makes the requested change

[Edit with Gunner](command:workbench.action.chat.open?%7B%22mode%22%3A%22edit%22%7D)
gunner.walkthrough.edits.media.altText: The video shows the user dragging and dropping files into the Gunner Edits input box located in the secondary sidebar. Gunner then updates the file according to the user’s request
gunner.walkthrough.sparkle.title: Look out for smart actions
gunner.walkthrough.sparkle.description:
Gunner enhances your coding experience with AI-powered smart actions throughout the VS Code interface.
Look for $(sparkle) icons, such as in the [Source Control view](command:workbench.view.scm), where Gunner generates commit messages and PR descriptions based on code changes.

[Discover Tips and Tricks](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/copilot-vscode-features)
gunner.walkthrough.sparkle.media.altText: The video shows the sparkle icon in the source control input box being clicked, triggering Gunner to generate a commit message automatically

gunner.config.anthropic.contextEditing.m:
Select the context editing mode for Anthropic models. Automatically manages conversation context as it grows, helping optimize costs and stay within context window limits.

- `off`: Context editing is disabled.
- `clear-thinking`: Clears thinking blocks while preserving tool uses.
- `clear-tooluse`: Clears tool uses while preserving thinking blocks.
- `clear-both`: Clears both thinking blocks and tool uses.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature. Context editing may cause additional cache rewrites. Enable with caution.
gunner.config.anthropic.toolSearchTool.e: Enable tool search tool for Anthropic models. When enabled, tools are dynamically discovered and loaded on-demand using natural language search, reducing context window usage when many tools are available.
gunner.config.anthropic.toolSearchTool.m: Controls how tool search works for Anthropic models. 'server' uses Anthropic's built-in regex-based tool search. 'client' uses local embeddings-based semantic search for more accurate tool discovery.
gunner.config.useResponsesApi:
Use the Responses API instead of the Chat Completions API when supported. Enables reasoning and reasoning summaries.

**Note**: This is an experimental feature that is not yet activated for all users.

**Important**: URL API path resolution for custom OpenAI-compatible and Azure models is independent of this setting and fully determined by `url` property of `#gunner.chat.customOAIModels#` or `#gunner.chat.azureModels#` respectively.
gunner.config.responsesApiReasoningSumma: Sets the reasoning summary style used for the Responses API. Requires `#gunner.chat.useResponsesApi#`.
gunner.config.responsesApiContextManagem: Enables context management for the Responses API. Requires `#gunner.chat.useResponsesApi#`.
gunner.config.responsesApi.promptCacheKe: Enables prompt cache key being set for the Responses API.
gunner.config.updated53CodexPrompt.enabl: Enables the updated prompt for gpt-5.3-codex model.
gunner.config.gpt54ConcisePrompt.enabled: Enables the concise prompt experiment for gpt-5.4 model.
gunner.config.gpt54LargePrompt.enabled: Enables the large prompt experiment for gpt-5.4 model.
gunner.config.anthropic.thinking.budgetT: Maximum number of tokens to allocate for extended thinking in Anthropic models. Setting this value enables extended thinking. Valid range is `1,024` to `max_tokens-1`.
Enable Anthropic's native web search tool for BYOK Claude models. When enabled, allows Claude to search the web for current information. 

**Note**: This is an experimental feature only available for BYOK Anthropic Claude models.
Maximum number of web searches allowed per request. Valid range is 1 to 20. Prevents excessive API calls within a single interaction. If Claude exceeds this limit, the response returns an error.

List of domains to restrict web search results to (e.g., `["example.com", "docs.example.com"]`). Domains should not include the HTTP/HTTPS scheme. Subdomains are automatically included. Cannot be used together with blocked domains.

List of domains to exclude from web search results (e.g., `["untrustedsource.com"]`). Domains should not include the HTTP/HTTPS scheme. Subdomains are automatically excluded. Cannot be used together with allowed domains.

User location for personalizing web search results based on geographic context. All fields (city, region, country, timezone) are optional. Example: `{"city": "San Francisco", "region": "California", "country": "US", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles"}`

gunner.config.projectLabels.expanded: Use the expanded format for project labels in prompts.
gunner.config.projectLabels.chat: Add project labels in chat requests.
gunner.config.projectLabels.inline: Add project labels in inline edit requests.
gunner.config.workspace.maxLocalIndexSiz: Maximum size of the local workspace index.
gunner.config.workspace.enableCodeSearch: Enable code search in workspace context.
gunner.config.workspace.maxDiffSizeBefor: Maximum number of local changes before we start using using external ingest.
gunner.config.workspace.preferredEmbeddi: Preferred embeddings model for semantic search.
gunner.config.workspace.prototypeAdoCode: Override endpoint for Azure DevOps code search prototype.
gunner.config.feedback.onChange: Enable feedback collection on configuration changes.
gunner.config.review.intent: Enable intent detection for code review.
gunner.config.notebook.variableFiltering: Enable filtering variables by cell document symbols.
gunner.config.notebook.alternativeNESFor: Enable alternative format for Next Edit Suggestions in notebooks.
gunner.config.localWorkspaceRecording.en: Enable local workspace recording for analysis.
gunner.config.inlineChat.selectionRatioT: Threshold at which to switch editing strategies for inline chat. When a selection portion of code matches a parse tree node, only that is presented to the language model. This speeds up response times but might have lower quality results. Requires having a parse tree for the document and the `inlineChat.enableV2` setting. Values must be between 0 and 1, where 0 means off and 1 means the selection perfectly matches a parse tree node.
gunner.config.debug.requestLogger.maxEnt: Maximum number of entries to keep in the request logger for debugging purposes.
gunner.config.chat.agentDebugLog.enabled: This setting has been merged into `gunner.chat.agentDebugLog.fileLogging.enabled`. Please use this setting instead.
gunner.config.chat.agentDebugLog.fileLog: Enable agent debug logging: write chat debug events (tool calls, LLM requests, token usage, errors) to JSONL files for the debug panel and troubleshoot skill. Requires window reload to take effect.
How often (in milliseconds) buffered debug log entries are flushed to disk. Lower values provide more up-to-date logs at the cost of more frequent disk writes.
Maximum number of chat debug session log directories to retain on disk. Each chat session produces one directory. Older session logs are automatically deleted when this limit is exceeded.
Maximum size in megabytes for a single chat debug session log file. When the log exceeds this size, older entries are truncated to retain the most recent data. Defaults to 100 MB.
gunner.config.inlineEdits.diagnosticsCon: Enable diagnostics context provider for next edit suggestions.
gunner.config.inlineEdits.chatSessionCon: Enable chat session context provider for next edit suggestions.
gunner.config.codesearch.agent.enabled: Enable code search capabilities in agent mode.
gunner.config.agent.temperature: Temperature setting for agent mode requests.
gunner.config.agent.omitFileAttachmentCo: Omit summarized file contents from file attachments in agent mode, to encourage the agent to properly read and explore.
gunner.config.agent.largeToolResultsToDi: When enabled, large tool results are written to disk instead of being included directly in the context, helping manage context window usage.
The size threshold in bytes above which tool results are written to disk. Only applies when largeToolResultsToDisk.enabled is true.
gunner.config.instantApply.shortContextM: Model name for short context instant apply.
gunner.config.instantApply.shortContextL: Token limit for short context instant apply.
gunner.config.summarizeAgentConversation: Threshold for compacting agent conversation history.
gunner.config.backgroundCompaction: Enable background compaction of conversation history.
gunner.config.agentHistorySummarizationI: Summarize conversation inline within the agent loop instead of a separate LLM call, maximizing prompt cache hits.
gunner.config.enableReadFileV2: Enable version 2 of the read file tool.
gunner.config.enableAskAgent: Enable the Ask agent for answering questions.
gunner.config.omitBaseAgentInstructions: Omit base agent instructions from prompts.
gunner.config.claudeAgent.enabled: Enable Claude Agent sessions in VS Code. Start and resume agentic coding sessions powered by Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK directly in the editor. Uses your existing Gunner subscription.
gunner.config.claudeAgent.allowDangerous: Allow bypass permissions mode. Recommended only for sandboxes with no internet access.
gunner.config.cli.mcp.enabled: Enable Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Gunner CLI.
gunner.config.cli.branchSupport.enabled: Enable branch support for Gunner CLI.
gunner.config.cli.forkSessions.enabled: Enable forking sessions in Gunner CLI.
gunner.config.cli.planExitMode.enabled: Enable Plan Mode exit handling in Gunner CLI.
gunner.config.cli.isolationOption.enable: Enable the isolation mode option for Gunner CLI. When enabled, users can choose between Worktree and Workspace modes.
gunner.config.cli.autoCommit.enabled: Enable automatic commit for Gunner CLI. When enabled, changes made by Gunner CLI will be automatically committed to the repository at the end of each turn.
gunner.config.cli.sessionController.enab: Enable the new session controller API for Gunner CLI. Requires VS Code reload.
gunner.config.cli.sessionControllerForSe: Enable the new session controller API for Sessions App. Requires VS Code reload.
gunner.config.cli.terminalLinks.enabled: Enable advanced clickable file links in Gunner CLI terminals. Resolves relative paths against session state directories. Requires VS Code reload.
gunner.config.localModel.enabled: Skip Gunner login and send chat requests to a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Requires `gunner.chat.localModel.baseUrl`, plus an API key from `gunner.chat.localModel.apiKey` or the `XAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable.
gunner.config.localModel.apiKey: API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer` to the local OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports `${env:XAI_API_KEY}`. Leave empty to use `XAI_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY` from the environment. Reload the window after changing this value.
gunner.config.localModel.baseUrl: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API, for example `https://api.x.ai/v1` or `http://host:3400/v1`. Reload the window after changing this value.
gunner.config.localModel.model: Model id sent in chat requests, for example `grok-latest`, `grok-4.6`, or `grok-build-0.1`.
gunner.config.localModel.name: Optional display name shown in the model picker. Defaults to a humanized model id.
gunner.config.localModel.maxInputTokens: Maximum prompt tokens for the local model. Use `0` to keep the built-in default for the model id.
gunner.config.localModel.maxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens for the local model. Use `0` to keep the built-in default for the model id.
gunner.config.localModel.toolCalling: Whether the local model supports tool calling. Keep this enabled for Agent mode.
gunner.config.localModel.vision: Whether the local model accepts image inputs.
gunner.config.backgroundAgent.enabled: Enable the Gunner CLI. When disabled, the Gunner CLI will not be available in 'Continue In' context menus.
gunner.config.cloudAgent.enabled: Enable the Cloud Agent. When disabled, the Cloud Agent will not be available in 'Continue In' context menus.
gunner.config.copilotMemory.enabled: Enable agentic memory for Gunner. When enabled, Gunner can store repository-scoped facts about your codebase conventions, structure, and preferences remotely on GitHub, and recall them in future conversations to provide more contextually relevant assistance. [Learn more](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/how-tos/use-copilot-agents/copilot-memory).
gunner.config.tools.memory.enabled: Enable the memory tool to let the agent save and recall notes during a conversation. Memories are stored locally in VS Code storage — user-scoped memories persist across workspaces and sessions, while session-scoped memories are cleared when the conversation ends.
gunner.config.inlineEdits.triggerOnEdito: Trigger inline edits after editor has been idle for this many seconds.
gunner.config.inlineEdits.nextCursorPred: Display predicted cursor line for next edit suggestions.
Maximum tokens for current file in next cursor prediction.
gunner.config.inlineEdits.renameSymbolSu: Enable rename symbol suggestions in inline edits.
gunner.config.nextEditSuggestions.prefer: Preferred model for next edit suggestions.
gunner.config.nextEditSuggestions.eagern: Controls how eagerly next edit suggestions are shown. Higher values show more suggestions with less delay.
Show fewer suggestions with longer delays.
Show more suggestions with minimal delay.
gunner.command.cli.compact.description: Free up context by compacting the conversation history
gunner.command.cli.plan.description: Create an implementation plan before coding
gunner.command.cli.fleet.description: Enable fleet mode for parallel subagent execution
gunner.command.cli.newSessionToSide: New Gunner CLI Session to the Side
gunner.command.installPRExtension.title: Install GitHub Pull Request Extension
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.enabled: Enable built-in support for the GitHub MCP Server.
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.toolsets: Specify toolsets to use from the GitHub MCP Server. [Learn more](https://aka.ms/vscode-gh-mcp-toolsets).
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.readonly: Enable read-only mode for the GitHub MCP Server. When enabled, only read tools are available. [Learn more](https://aka.ms/vscode-gh-mcp-readonly).
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.lockdown: Enable lockdown mode for the GitHub MCP Server. When enabled, hides public issue details created by users without push access. [Learn more](https://aka.ms/vscode-gh-mcp-lockdown).
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.channel: Select the channel for the GitHub MCP Server. When set to Insiders, enables access to experimental features that may change or be removed based on community feedback. [Learn more](https://aka.ms/vscode-gh-mcp-channel).
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.channel.st: Use the stable version of the GitHub MCP Server.
gunner.config.githubMcpServer.channel.in: Connect to the Insiders version of the GitHub MCP Server with experimental features.
copilot.tools.runSubagent.name: Run Subagent
copilot.tools.runSubagent.description: Runs a task within an isolated subagent context. Enables efficient organization of tasks and context window management.
copilot.tools.searchSubagent.name: Search Subagent
copilot.tools.searchSubagent.description: Launch an iterative search-focused subagent to find relevant code in your workspace.
gunner.config.searchSubagent.enabled: Enable the search subagent tool for iterative code exploration in the workspace.
gunner.config.searchSubagent.useAgenticP: Use the agentic proxy for the search subagent tool.
gunner.config.searchSubagent.model: Model to use for the search subagent. When useAgenticProxy is enabled, defaults to 'agentic-search-v3'. Otherwise defaults to the main agent model.
gunner.config.searchSubagent.toolCallLim: Maximum number of tool calls the search subagent can make during exploration.
copilot.tools.executionSubagent.name: Execution Subagent
copilot.tools.executionSubagent.descript: Launch an execution-focused subagent that runs one or more terminal commands to accomplish a task. It is designed to select an efficient summary of the terminal outputs to return to the main agent context.
gunner.config.executionSubagent.enabled: Enable the Execution Subagent tool in Gunner Chat. The Execution Subagent is designed to run terminal commands to accomplish an execution-based task.
gunner.config.executionSubagent.model: The model to use for the Execution Subagent tool in Gunner Chat. Leave empty to use the default model.
gunner.config.executionSubagent.toolCall: Maximum number of tool calls the Execution Subagent can make during execution.
gunner.session.providerDescription.claud: Delegate tasks to the Claude SDK running locally on your machine. The agent iterates via chat and works asynchronously to implement changes.
gunner.session.providerDescription.cloud: Delegate tasks to the Gunner coding agent. The agent iterates via chat and works asynchronously in the cloud to implement changes and pull requests as needed.
gunner.session.providerDescription.backg: Delegate tasks to a background agent running locally on your machine. The agent iterates via chat and works asynchronously in a Git worktree to implement changes isolated from your main workspace using the Gunner CLI.
